description: Find AI tools for a task or need (e.g. "edit podcast audio", "AI video avatars", "SEO keyword research"), ranked by real web traffic. Optional filters: category, free plan only, max monthly price in USD. Returns tools with pricing, rank and a link to each tool's AIWiseRank page.

category.description: Optional category: Software Engineering, Design & Creative, AI Models, Customer Support, Writing & Content, Productivity, Marketing & SEO, Data Analytics, Video Production, Sales Intelligence

free_plan_only.description: Only tools with a confirmed free plan or free tier.

max_monthly_usd.description: Budget: only tools whose entry paid plan costs at most this much per month (USD list prices). Tools with a free plan always count as within budget.

query.description: What the user wants to do or the kind of tool, in plain words.

name: search_ai_tools
title: Search AI tools
